jp: 部屋[へや]{の|no-possessive}掃除[そうじ]{を|o-object}毎日[まいにち]{は|wa-negative}しません。
en: I don't clean my room every day.
why: は after 毎日 in a negative means 'not every day' (but some days).

jp: この家[いえ]{は|wa-topic}新[あたら]しく{は|wa-negative}ありません{が/けど|ga-but}、住[す]みやすいです。
en: This house isn't new, but it is easy to live in.
why: は after the く-form of an adjective plus ない marks a limited denial: 'not new (but...)'.

jp: 父[ちち]{は|wa-topic}お酒[さけ]{を|o-object}たくさん{は|wa-negative}飲[の]みません。
en: My father doesn't drink a lot of alcohol.
why: は after たくさん in a negative sentence means 'not a lot' (a little is fine).

jp: 母[はは]{に|ni-target}毎日[まいにち]{は|wa-negative}電話[でんわ]できません。
en: I can't phone my mother every day.
why: は after 毎日 with a negative potential means 'not every day'.

jp: 昼間[ひるま]、母[はは]{は|wa-topic}家[いえ]{に|ni-location}ずっと{は|wa-negative}いません。
en: During the day my mother isn't at home all the time.
why: は after ずっと in a negative means 'not the whole time'.

jp: 駅[えき]{から|kara-from}家[いえ]{まで|made-until}、そんなに遠[とお]く{は|wa-negative}ありません。
en: It isn't that far from the station to my house.
why: は after the く-form of an adjective plus ありません softens the denial to 'not that far'.

jp: 母[はは]{は|wa-topic}テレビ{を/は|o-object}長[なが]く{は|wa-negative}見[み]ません。
en: My mother doesn't watch TV for long.
why: は after 長く in a negative means 'not for long periods'.

jp: 子[こ]ども{に|ni-recipient}おやつ{を|o-object}一日[いちにち]三回[さんかい]{は|wa-negative}あげません。
en: I don't give my child snacks as often as three times a day.
why: は after a count in a negative means 'not as many as three times'.

jp: 祖母[そぼ]{は|wa-topic}スマホ{を|o-object}上手[じょうず]に{は|wa-negative}使[つか]えません。
en: My grandmother can't use a smartphone very well.
why: は after the adverb 上手に in a negative means 'not skilfully'.

jp: 仕事[しごと]{が|ga-subject}忙[いそが]しくて、実家[じっか]{に/へ|ni-destination}しょっちゅう{は|wa-negative}帰[かえ]れません。
en: I'm busy at work, so I can't go back to my parents' home very often.
why: は after しょっちゅう in a negative means 'not very often'.

jp: 父[ちち]{は|wa-topic}出張[しゅっちょう]{が|ga-subject}多[おお]くて、あまり家[いえ]{に|ni-location}{は|wa-negative}いません。
en: My father travels a lot for work, so he isn't home much.
why: は after に marks a limited denial: he is not at home much, though he is elsewhere.

jp: 薄[うす]い味[あじ]{が|ga-stative}好[す]きな{ので|node-because}、料理[りょうり]{を|o-object}濃[こ]く{は|wa-negative}しません。
en: I like mild flavours, so I don't make my food strong.
why: は after the く-form plus しません means 'I don't make it (that) strong'.
